result.notes: Two distinct public API surfaces: (1) Management API (api.supabase.com) for org/project admin, auth via Personal Access Tokens or OAuth2, sent as Authorization: Bearer <token>; (2) per-project auto-generated Data API (PostgREST-based REST + pg_graphql-based GraphQL) authenticated via project API keys (anon/service_role) behind a key-auth gateway, layered with Postgres Row Level Security. Free tier gives unlimited API requests but pauses inactive free projects after 1 week and caps at 2 active projects. Management API alone spans 15+ resource categories (projects, organizations, branches, functions, storage, auth config, secrets, etc.) with multiple endpoints each, comfortably >300 total when combined with per-table Data API surface, hence "large" breadth (approximate, no single endpoint-count page fetched). Official MCP server published by Supabase at github.com/supabase/mcp with a hosted endpoint at mcp.supabase.com/mcp, alongside numerous community MCP servers (self-hosted variants, lite versions) per registry hints.
result.one_liner: Supabase is an open-source Firebase alternative providing a hosted Postgres database with auto-generated REST/GraphQL APIs, auth, storage, edge functions, and a Management API for provisioning projects.
